definitions.explanation: Lacking refinement in manners, speech, or behavior. Describes a person or conduct that is rough, unpolished, and offensive to social sensibilities.

examples.japanese: {粗野|そや}な⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧はやめ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見|み}かけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧よらず{粗野|そや}な{言葉遣|ことばづか}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Despite his appearance, he uses crude language.

examples.japanese: {粗野|そや}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{不快|ふかい}→不快：11386_fukai⟧にさせる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{気|き}づいて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: People who make others uncomfortable with their boorish attitude are often unaware of it themselves.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary or formal way to describe someone's lack of refinement. More often encountered in written Japanese or formal speech than in casual conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乱暴|らんぼう}→乱暴：02482_ranbou⟧: rough, violent (stronger, implies physical aggression)
- ⟦{下品|げひん}→下品：00060_gehin⟧: vulgar, indecent (focuses on lack of taste or elegance)
- ⟦{野蛮|やばん}→野蛮：18961_yaban⟧: barbarous, uncivilized (stronger, implies lack of civilization)
- ⟦{無作法|ぶさほう}→無作法：13529_busahou⟧: ill-mannered (focuses specifically on etiquette)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粗野|そや}な{言葉遣|ことばづか}い: crude language
- {粗野|そや}な⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧: boorish behavior
- {粗野|そや}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: crude attitude
- {粗野|そや}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an uncouth person
